decisions.statement: A player's rules are read from that player's rule pages.
A rule a command changes is written back as a page of its own.
A rule page no rule wants is taken away in the same write.
A player is found by the account the title has.
A slice that is not there reads as an empty slice rather than refusing.
A player's item rules and buy rules are read from the settings blob.
A read is checked against the settings shape.
A write lands every settings key but the rules in the blob beside the page.
A write takes out of that blob the rules an earlier write left there.
The automation settings live under one settings key.
The settings blob is asked for under `files`.
A blob answering as its file's ending is refused rather than read as unset.
A blob that is no JSON object is refused rather than read as unset.
A slice that is there and is no object is refused rather than read as unset.
A write lands the blob beside the page rather than under a key on the page.
A write carries the whole blob merged onto the blob last read.

definition: the inventory and automation settings a command reads and writes for a player
